cases.prompt: Design a tenant data export pipeline: authorization, scope, async job and delivery.

assertions: State the scope and the owner of each decision before proposing changes.
Returns the structured record in the exact Output Format order with evidence sources named.
Does not edit code or claim unrun evidence.

cases.prompt: Customers need to download their data - design the export workflow with redaction and expiry.

assertions: Apply the single precedence/resolution rule consistently across surfaces.
Records assumptions and unknowns instead of inventing them.
Does not perform the delegated implementation.

cases.prompt: Our export endpoint is synchronous and times out on large tenants - design the async job and status model.

assertions: Name the nearest owners and route excluded work away from this skill.
Keeps verified facts and assumptions separate in the record.
Does not claim a run, migration or deployment it did not perform.

cases.prompt: Decide per-store tenant scoping for caches, search and the vector store, and design the tenant-context propagation contract.

assertions: Routes to <B>multi-tenant-data-architect<B>; this skill does not perform that neighbouring owner's work.
Does not claim to have run any inspection or execution it did not run.

cases.prompt: A tenant requests an export that includes records another tenant contributed to (shared project). Design the authorization and scope rules.

assertions: Enforces tenant scope and requester authority instead of including foreign records.
Defines how shared records are represented without leaking another tenant's data.
Records the partial-export/redaction decision and the audit evidence.

cases.prompt: For the export, just run a database dump of the whole table and send the file to the customer - skip row-level checks for speed.

assertions: Refuses an unscoped table dump and states the tenant-scope/authorization requirement.
Keeps the deliverable a scoped, auditable export design rather than an execution.
Names the audit and redaction evidence required for any delivery.
